description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates the use of RadioGroup and RadioButton UI components, including adding radio buttons programmatically, handling checked change events, and clearing selections.

classes.name: RadioGroup1
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating RadioGroup usage, including dynamic addition of radio buttons and event handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity layout, initializes RadioGroup and Button, adds a radio button programmatically, and sets event listeners.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in radio button selection within the RadioGroup, updating the TextView with the selected radio button's ID.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Clears the current radio button selection within the RadioGroup when the clear button is clicked.
